component.name: Kestrel
component.summary: Chat privately with local models on your own machine

description.p: Kestrel is a local-first desktop workspace for talking to models that run on your own hardware. Prompts, responses, and model files stay on the machine unless an external integration is deliberately enabled.
It can drive a GGUF model through llama.cpp, with or without an NVIDIA GPU, and reports the device and backend it actually found rather than assuming one.
